title: One integer past Long.MAX_VALUE stops being a number and becomes a quoted string
rationale: NP-015 was fixed by making an out-of-range BigInteger fall back to exact decimal text instead of silently wrapping negative. That fix is right, but it was only ever measured at the Map level. End to end, a JSON number turns into a JSON string and the document changes shape in a way that breaks any consumer with a typed schema.
catchesBugClass: A regression to the NP-015 wrap-around, and equally a regression in the other direction if someone narrows the string back to a long. Also catches the absence of a type sidecar.
cannotCatch: It cannot distinguish "defensible transport choice" from "bug" on its own - that is the human classification this fixture exists to force. It is also invisible to JsonReconstructor.verify(), which calls String and Number compatible types.

predicted.detail: i64max survives as a number; i64maxPlus1 and huge are parsed as BigInteger, hit longValueExact, and fall back to decimal text. No digit is lost; the TYPE is.
